lines.say: freed from food by stomach acid, then absorbed with intrinsic factor
needed to make red cells; deficiency can cause megaloblastic anemia and fatigue
needed for the nerves; deficiency can damage them even without anemia
B12 levels normalize by mouth about as well as by injection (small trials)
B12 checked, with methylmalonic acid (most sensitive) and homocysteine
B12 runs low more often on metformin or long-term acid reducers, which can cut absorption

ask: Should my B12 be checked, given my diet, age or medicines like metformin or acid reducers?
